title: 第25章 林师弟我信你请你守护宗门尊严第26章 你嘴里的那颗假牙必须还给我
lines: 山峰前。
两道身影破空而来，转眼而至。
“姜长老，当年师父真的败给了云霓？”
在洛雪看来，师父身为八重龙象神魔高手，竟然会败给湮鼎宗宗主云霓。
一声叹息！
姜素雪苦涩道：“三年前，宗主因为某种原因独自杀上湮鼎宗，和云霓一战落败，将冰神剑留在湮鼎宗三年，此事也成为了宗主的最大心病。”
“小雪，你已经突破到巅峰筑基境，同阶无敌，稍后你只需要击败同阶湮鼎宗弟子即可。”
来到湮鼎宗前。
姜素雪仰天发出一声长啸，声浪滚滚。
“冰神宗长老姜素雪，奉宗主之命前来湮鼎宗，取回冰神剑。”
破空声响起。
爽朗笑声滚滚传来，韩飞快步而来，抱拳道：“原来是姜长老，多年未见，别来无恙。”
“韩长老，我想见云宗主。”
“不行。”
“为何？”
姜素雪眼神顿时一沉，难道云霓不想还冰神剑？
云霓身为湮鼎宗宗主，这点信誉还是应该有的。
韩飞摇摇头，笑着说道：“宗主有事外出，暂时无法回来，不过宗主临走之前已经吩咐过了，要是冰神宗来人，请自行前往大殿取走冰神剑。”
“哼！云宗主明显是故意的。”
“小雪，闭嘴！”
姜素雪笑着说道：“韩长老莫要见怪，这是我家宗主所收的关门弟子，有些任性。”
“姜长老，请。”
大殿左侧，插着一柄冰蓝色长剑，正是冰神宗宗主的身份象征，冰神剑。
当年冰神宗宗主杀上湮鼎宗，败在云霓手里，只能将冰神剑留下，为期三年。
冰神宗宗主无颜来取，只能派出自己的弟子洛雪，在姜素雪的带领下，前来湮鼎宗取剑。
“韩长老，我拜在师父门下数月时间，一直听说湮鼎宗的弟子很厉害，所以今日我想趁着这个机会，和湮鼎宗的弟子切磋，不知道韩长老是否愿意。”
数月？
巅峰筑基境？
韩飞瞬间明白洛雪的用意。
湮鼎宗有凝轮境弟子，但无一例外，进入湮鼎宗都是数年时间，并且人家是筑基境，难道要凝轮境弟子切磋？
“小雪不要胡闹，这里是湮鼎宗，要是你击败所有同阶之人，湮鼎宗颜面何存。”
故意的！
韩飞很是愤怒，却没有丝毫办法。
“既然洛雪想要切磋，那我湮鼎宗接着便是。”
半个时辰后。
“承让！”
穆青擦了擦嘴角渗出的鲜血，唏嘘道：“洛姑娘手段高超，我自愧不如。”
“连穆师兄都败了，这个洛雪还真是厉害，已经连败十三人，纵观宗门，除非是凝轮境的师兄师姐们出手，否则的话，同阶筑基境之中，无人是她的敌手。”
content_en:
In front of the mountain.
Two figures came through the sky and arrived in the blink of an eye.
"Elder Jiang, did master really lose to Yun Ni back then?"
In Luo Xue's view, the master, as a master of the eighth-level dragon, elephant, gods and demons, would actually lose to Yun Ni, the master of the Yiding Sect.
A sigh!
Jiang Suxue said bitterly: "Three years ago, the sect leader committed suicide alone in the Yin Ding Sect for some reason. He lost a battle with Yun Ni and left the Ice Divine Sword in the Yin Ding Sect for three years. This matter has become the biggest worry for the sect leader."
"Xiaoxue, you have broken through to the peak foundation-building realm and are invincible at the same level. Later you only need to defeat the disciples of the Diding Sect at the same level."
"Yes."
Arrive in front of the Yan Ding Sect.
Jiang Suxue looked up to the sky and let out a long roar, the sound was rolling.
"Jiang Suxue, the elder of the Ice God Sect, came to the Annihilation Sect on the order of the sect leader to retrieve the Ice God Sword."
A sound broke through the air.
Hearty laughter came rolling in, Han Fei came quickly, clasped his fists and said: "It turns out to be Elder Jiang. I haven't seen you for many years. I'm fine."
"Elder Han, I want to see Sect Master Yun."
"No."
"Why?"
Jiang Suxue's eyes suddenly darkened, didn't Yun Ni want to return the Ice Divine Sword?
As the leader of the Yiding Sect, Yun Ni should still have this credibility.
Han Fei shook his head and said with a smile: "The sect master is out for something and cannot come back for the time being. However, the sect master has already given instructions before leaving. If anyone comes from the Ice God Sect, please go to the main hall to pick up the Ice God Sword."
"Hmph! Master Yun obviously did it on purpose."
"Xiaoxue, shut up!"
Jiang Suxue said with a smile: "Elder Han, don't be offended. This is a closed disciple accepted by my sect leader. He is a bit willful."
"Elder Jiang, please."
"Please."
On the left side of the main hall, there is an ice blue long sword, which is the identity symbol of the leader of the Ice God Sect, the Ice God Sword.
Back then, the leader of the Ice God Sect attacked the Diding Sect and was defeated by Yun Ni, so he could only keep the Ice God Sword for a period of three years.
The leader of the Ice God Sect was too embarrassed to come to retrieve the sword, so he could only send his disciple Luo Xue, led by Jiang Suxue, to come to the Annihilation Cauldron Sect to retrieve the sword.
"Elder Han, I have been under Master's disciples for several months, and I have always heard that the disciples of the Yaoding Sect are very powerful, so today I want to take this opportunity to compete with the disciples of the Yaoding Sect. I wonder if Elder Han is willing."
How many months?
Peak foundation building realm?
Han Fei instantly understood Luo Xue's intention.
There are Ninglun Realm disciples in the Yan Ding Sect, but without exception, it takes several years to enter the Yan Ding Sect, and they are at the Foundation Establishment Realm. Do they need Ning Lun Realm disciples to compete with each other?
"Xiaoxue, don't be ridiculous. This is the Dioding Sect. If you defeat everyone of the same level, the Dioding Sect will lose face."
On purpose!
Han Fei was very angry, but there was nothing he could do.
"Since Luo Xue wants to learn from each other, then I, the Diding Sect, will take over."
Half an hour later.
"Concession!"
Mu Qing wiped the blood seeping from the corner of her mouth and sighed: "Miss Luo is so skillful, I am ashamed of herself."
"Even Senior Brother Mu has been defeated. This Luo Xue is really powerful. She has defeated thirteen people in a row. Looking at the sect, unless the senior brothers and sisters in the Condensing Wheel Realm take action, no one in the same level of Foundation Establishment Realm can be her opponent."
title_en: Chapter 25: Junior Brother Lin, I trust you and ask you to protect the dignity of the sect. Chapter 26: The dentures in your mouth must be returned to me.
